Instance.new("UICorner",f).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,16)

local grad=Instance.new("UIGradient",f)

 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,Color3.fromRGB(160,100,255)),
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(80,220,255))

local title=Instance.new("TextLabel",f)

local function speedBtn(txt,delay,pos)

 b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35)
 Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)
 b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
  spamDelay=delay
 end)
end

speedBtn("1s",1,UDim2.new(0,0,0,0))
speedBtn("2s",2,UDim2.new(0.35,0,0,0))

-- Info
local info=Instance.new("TextLabel",f)

 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(255,70,70)),
 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(255,160,90))
}
local bStroke=Instance.new("UIStroke",b)
bStroke.Thickness=3

-- Hide/Show Button
local hb=Instance.new("TextButton",g)
hb.Size=UDim2.new(0,70,0,32)

hb.Text="HIDE"
hb.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold

 ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,Color3.fromRGB(160,100,255)),

 bGrad.Rotation-=dt*50

hb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
 f.Visible=not f.Visible
 hb.Text=f.Visible and "HIDE" or "SHOW"
end)

-- Logic (RESET ON RESTART)
local lastTap=0
b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
 if tick()-lastTap<0.35 then
  f.Visible=not f.Visible
 else
  run=not run
  b.Text=run and "ON" or "OFF"
  if run then
   msgIndex=1
   bGrad.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(80,255,150),Color3.fromRGB(60,200,120))
   task.spawn(function()
    while run do
     if not msgs[msgIndex] then msgIndex=1 end
     ch:SendAsync(

     )
     msgIndex+=1
     task.wait(spamDelay)
    end
   end)
  else
   bGrad.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255,70,70),Color3.fromRGB(255,160,90))
